report_assessment: Major revision: false auxiliary flux and speed bounds; hair-trigger proof gap; missing logarithmic phase in a core comparison function; local scope and formula corrections

issues.location: Lemma3.1 pp10-11 Eq3.2; proof Eqs3.16-3.20 pp17-19; Cor3.2 pp19-20
issues.claim: Pressure-gradient estimate false in stated convection and p<2 regimes
issues.evidence: p=m2,h0,gamma>0 exact bounded increasing front has nondecaying pressure gradient with arbitrary initial translation; p3/2,m3,gamma0,h0 compact even Barenblatt scaling has |v_x|(lambda,lambda^1.5)=1/(16lambda) versus C lambda^-3/4.
issues.counterevidence: First example uses bounded noncompact class explicitly stated in Lemma; second is compact and even. Main asymptotics require p>=2; Theorem2.6 only needs unspecified bound at fixedtau,rho.
issues.repair: Retain convection remainder and correct time/scaling powers; redo radial derivation and limiting maximum argument.
issues.impact_boundary: False auxiliary estimate and defective proof; weaker Theorem2.6 and final radial asymptotics not disproved.

acceptance_check.source_claim_and_assumptions: Lemma3.1 pp10-11 applies to bounded nonnegative solutions of the constant-convection problem with h=0 allowed and C independent of initial translation. Its p<2 branch is wider than the p>=2 main asymptotic hypotheses.
acceptance_check.independent_argument: For m=p=2 the increasing zero-flux front has (F^2)'+gamma F^2=gamma M F and stationary positive pressure gradient at any prescribed late translated front, contradicting t^-1/2 decay. For p=3/2,m=3 the even compact Barenblatt has flux -xB/(2s); parabolic scaling gives 1/(16lambda) versus C lambda^-3/4. The interface flux vanishes and the examples meet the respective stated solution classes.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_core_dependency: No implication that the weaker fixed-tau,rho bound in Theorem2.6 or p>=2 final radial convergence is false. The advertised flux estimate and its radial derivation are central technical dependencies.
acceptance_check.repair_scope: Retain the convection remainder and correct scaling; re-establish the radial bound rather than assuming the stronger false formula.

issues.evidence: Differentiate pressure ODE: Y'-aY=c'/((m-alpha)q)+|P|^(p-2). Explicit m1,p3,h_a=a^3 u^1.5(1-u)(4-3u) below1 and -a^3(u-1) above1; sharp tanh^2(a xi/2) wave. Asserted regularity forces c'_a(0)=-a J/I; J/I>=5 exp(-1/2)/(64sqrt2), so a100 violates -m.

issues.repair: Correct difference quotient/source, endpoint and C2 argument; revise continuation range and bounds.
issues.impact_boundary: Does not refute final asymptotic with actual c_sharp=-c'(0)/c*.

acceptance_check.source_claim_and_assumptions: Lemma4.15 pp30-32 assumes SDR and p>=2 and asserts a C2 parameter branch with c' in(-m,0).
acceptance_check.independent_argument: Differentiation of y=W^(p-1) produces the nonhomogeneous W^(p-2) term. The m=1,p=3,C1 admissible h_a and exact tanh-squared front force c'_a(0)=-a J/I under the asserted regularity. J/I>=5e^-1/2/(64sqrt2); a=100 yields magnitude at least3.35064>m. The exact trajectory and integrating-factor identities were independently recomputed by the bounded native helper, with actual payload/results retained; primary checked the analytic endpoint and integral-bound reasoning.

The actual derivative can remain negative with a profile-dependent bound, so c_sharp defined by the actual derivative is not disproved. Parameter inversion and the logarithmic-barrier proof require repaired estimates.
acceptance_check.repair_scope: Correct the variation/source and compatible endpoint formula, continuation bound and C2 estimates.

issues.evidence: N1,p=m2,delta1/2,hhat=u^4[1-16(u-3/4)_+^2]; w=u0^2 in H01(-1,1),0<w<=1/4. Alleged -w''<=w^2 gives pi²/4 intw² <= intw³ <=1/4 intw². Exactsigma4beta2 pointZ>0.

issues.impact_boundary: Major proof gap in Theorem2.2 dependency; no established spreading counterexample.

acceptance_check.source_claim_and_assumptions: Lemma5.2 p34 claims that taking beta,sigma sufficiently large makes a fixed-support, fixed-amplitude initial bump a static subsolution for allowed hhat.
acceptance_check.independent_argument: With N=1,m=p=2,delta=1/2 and admissible hhat=u^4[1-16(u-3/4)_+^2], w=underlineu^2 lies in H01(-1,1),0<=w<=1/4 and is nonzero. Testing -w''<=w^2 by w contradicts pi^2/4 int w^2<=int w^3<=1/4 int w^2. This excludes every sufficiently regular proposed large-exponent bump; the positive sample residual is supplementary.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_core_dependency: Lemma5.1 provides only a limsup; the invalid temporal monotonicity step is needed for the stated center limit and Theorem2.2 proof. It does not exhibit failure of spreading itself.
acceptance_check.repair_scope: Supply a different valid monotonicity/center-limit or hair-trigger argument.
